analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($671.31) vs SMA5 ($682.83)/SMA20 ($692.86)/SMA50 ($700.70): indicating short- to mid-term downtrend.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($697.84)/SMA200 ($670.92): in the mid- to long-term bearish zone.
· 52-week position (66.3%) + current price range is in a rebound phase from historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (49.9 → 36.6): entering oversold territory, downtrend continues.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.8624 → -2.0098): worsening, signaling continued weakness.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $669.20) + band width narrowing to 6.83%, indicating reduced volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($670.16): based on SMA200, approaching this level.
· Swing resistance ($689.10): a breakout could signal a short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: sideways consolidation, lack of directional momentum.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.48x): movement is gaining traction, increasing reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis: oversold territory reached during a downtrend, short-term bounce possible but trend reversal unconfirmed.
